location.ref: Sār Bachan (prose), on the soul's descent

paraphrase: The soul descended from the pure spiritual regions through the realms of Brahm and māyā into the body, where it is bound by mind and matter and scattered through the nine doors; it must be gathered at the eye centre and return by the current by which it came.
speaker: Soamiji Maharaj
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Sant Mat teaching (recent); locator at book/part level only.

location.ref: Sār Bachan (prose), on the Sant Satguru

paraphrase: Without a living Sant Satguru the soul cannot cross the regions of Kāl; the Sant alone knows the way, gives the secret of the sound and protects the disciple within.
speaker: Soamiji Maharaj
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Sant Mat teaching (recent); locator at book/part level only.

location.ref: Sār Bachan (prose), on the name Radhasoami

paraphrase: Radhasoami is the name of the supreme being, the highest region and the true name revealed by the Sant; Rādhā is the soul (surat) and Soamī the Lord; the soul is a drop of that ocean.
speaker: Soamiji Maharaj
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Sant Mat teaching (recent); locator at book/part level only. The Rādhā = soul, Soamī = Lord gloss is from the Agra literature (moderate).

location.ref: Sār Bachan (verse), on the regions and their sounds

paraphrase: The soul hears the bell and the conch at the thousand-petalled lotus, the drum-like thunder at Trikuṭī, the sārangī in Sunn, the flute at Bhanwar Guphā and the vīṇā in Sat Lok, and goes on to Alakh, Agam and Radhasoami.
speaker: Soamiji Maharaj
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Sant Mat teaching (recent); locator at book/part level only. The assignment of sounds to regions follows the Beas-line presentation (e.g. Path of the Masters); the Agra texts differ in detail.
